tasks.city:build: deno run -A jsr:@marianmeres/deno-build --root example/city --entry main.ts --outdir example/city/dist
tasks.city:watch: deno run -A jsr:@marianmeres/deno-build --root example/city --entry main.ts --outdir example/city/dist --watch --watch-dir src
tasks.nature:build: deno run -A jsr:@marianmeres/deno-build --root example/nature --entry main.ts --outdir example/nature/dist
tasks.nature:watch: deno run -A jsr:@marianmeres/deno-build --root example/nature --entry main.ts --outdir example/nature/dist --watch --watch-dir src
tasks.build:all: deno task city:theme && deno task city:build && deno task nature:theme && deno task nature:build
tasks.npm:publish: deno run -A scripts/build-npm.ts && cd ./.npm-dist && npm publish --access=public
tasks.rp: deno task release -y && deno task publish
tasks.rpm: deno task release minor -y && deno task publish
